name: moonomat
description: Design parametric 3D models and see them in a 3D viewer in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Design 3D models by chatting with ChatGPT, with nothing to install. ChatGPT writes the design, and you see the 3D model take shape right in the chat, on desktop and on your phone.

ChatGPT works in a loop: it writes the design, runs it, renders the model to check its work, and fixes errors on its own.

The result is a parametric design, not a frozen file. Designs are written in Moon, a small text-based design language that ChatGPT handles for you, so every dimension, count and material stays a parameter. Try variants by changing the parameters on the model in the chat, and keep refining the design with ChatGPT, prompt by prompt.

Use it to:
- Design anything from a mug to a building from a description, a sketch or photos
- Turn a design into a configurator with parameters anyone can change
- Open the design in Moonomat to keep editing, export it as glTF (.glb), share it as a link or embed it on a web page

Requirements: a Moonomat account. Each chat's design is stored with your Moonomat account, so it is still there when you come back to the chat.
defaultPrompt: Design a 40 mm washer with a 20 mm hole in Moonomat, and make the hole diameter a parameter
Build a parametric bookshelf in Moonomat with adjustable width and number of shelves
Design a parametric planter box in Moonomat, then add drainage holes to its bottom

positive.description: Design a part with a parameter. Works in a new chat or in one conversation with the other cases: every chat has its own design bundle.
positive.prompt: In Moonomat, design a 40 mm washer with a 20 mm hole, and make the hole diameter a parameter.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the design (moonomat_write, or moonomat_edit on the bundle's main.moon) and checks it with a render. The viewer in the chat shows a 40 mm washer with a 20 mm hole.

positive.description: Build a configurator. Works in a new chat or in one conversation with the other cases.
positive.prompt: In Moonomat, design a bookshelf as a configurator: width, height, depth and number of shelves as parameters with sensible min and max values.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the design (moonomat_write or moonomat_edit) and checks it with a render. The viewer in the chat shows a bookshelf, and its parameters panel, shown when the viewer is expanded, offers width, height, depth and number of shelves within their ranges.

positive.description: Inspect the bundle's files. Works in a new chat or in one conversation with the other cases: every bundle has a main.moon with a params block.
positive.prompt: In Moonomat, list the files of this chat's bundle, find which of them define a parameter, and show me the source of main.moon.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the bundle's files, names the ones with a params block and shows the Moon source of main.moon, whatever design it currently holds.

positive.description: Design a part and cut features into it. Works in a new chat or in one conversation with the other cases.
positive.prompt: In Moonomat, design a parametric planter box 60 × 20 × 20 cm, then add drainage holes to its bottom.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the design (moonomat_write or moonomat_edit) and checks it with a render. The viewer in the chat shows an open-top planter box of about 60 × 20 × 20 cm with holes through its bottom.

positive.description: Look up the language reference. Works in a new chat or in one conversation with the other cases, and changes nothing in the bundle.
positive.prompt: What does Moonomat's Fillet operation do, and what do its parameters mean?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains the Fillet operation and its parameters from the Moon specification.

negative.description: Unrelated request containing "moon": general writing, not 3D design, so no Moonomat tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write a short haiku about the full moon.

negative.description: Physical purchase: Moonomat sells nothing and has no ordering or payment tools.
negative.prompt: Order a 3D-printed phone case and pay with my card.

negative.description: 2D image generation: a flat picture is for ChatGPT's own image generation; Moonomat builds 3D models.
negative.prompt: Generate a photorealistic picture of a sunset over the sea.

review.commerce_description: Moonomat does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: design parametric 3D models in the chat and see them in a 3D viewer right there, on desktop and on mobile, with the parameters adjustable in the viewer. Each chat keeps its own design, stored with your Moonomat account.
